lines.en: I give Kirin a call, but instead of me coming to meet up with her like things usually go, she takes it upon herself to come visit me instead.
lines.zh: 我给 Kirin 打了个电话，不过这次不是像往常那样我去找她，而是她主动来找我。

lines.en: I try to stop this considering that a certain redhead also lives in this neighborhood and the idea of her seeing Kirin and me together is relatively alarming, but it does no good as she arrives less than 30 minutes later.
lines.zh: 我试图阻止，因为某个红发女孩也住在这一带，让她看见我和 Kirin 在一起可相当不妙，但没用——不到三十分钟她就到了。

lines.en: What’s even worse is that she winds up directly outside of my door in complete disregard of all of the warnings I gave her beforehand.
lines.zh: 更糟的是，她直接站在了我家门口，完全无视我之前给她的所有警告。

lines.en: Thankfully, Ami is in the bath at the time of her arrival, so I’m able to slip outside without being noticed as I take Kirin somewhere more private in an unfortunately platonic way.
lines.zh: 幸好她到的时候 Ami 正在洗澡，所以我能悄悄溜出去不被发现，把 Kirin 带到一个更私密的地方——可惜是以一种纯友谊的方式。

lines.en: I’m sure she did all of this on purpose, and I’m sure that she was {i}hoping{/i} Ami would catch her as it would be one more piece of drama she could feed off of to make herself feel good.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定她是故意这么做的，也敢肯定她{i}希望{/i} Ami 撞见她，因为那又是一出能让她拿来喂饱自己、让自己好受些的戏码。

lines.en: Or at least {i}attempt{/i} to make herself feel good, but regret it in secret while she cries herself to sleep the following night.
lines.zh: 或者至少是{i}试图{/i}让自己好受些，然后在第二天晚上偷偷后悔着哭着入睡。

lines.en: No one cries at all tonight, though, as nothing horrible happens.
lines.zh: 不过今晚谁也没哭，因为什么可怕的事都没发生。

lines.en: We just take a mostly silent walk through the streets of my neighborhood, clinging to the shadows like they’re handrails, and pretending that we don’t see the world through shit-colored glasses.
lines.zh: 我们只是几乎沉默地穿过我家附近的街道，像抓着扶手一样贴着阴影，假装自己不是戴着屎色眼镜看这个世界。

lines.en: But then it ends, and she goes home and cries herself to sleep anyway.
lines.zh: 可它还是结束了，她回了家，照样哭着入睡。
